{{Quote|Subject 13. You have been vanquished. Now take my mind, and serve the Empire. It is your only choice!|Suvaar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Suvaar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Mohgren]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Mohgren sought to free the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Subject 13]] from a [[mind prison]], and Suvaar willingly offered his body to Subject 13 for the Rakata to take control of.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suvaar appears in the Imperial mission "Subject 13" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
